baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e High Elves army book (Phoenix King and princes of the Ten Kingdoms; citizen-militia levy of every able elf; Sea Guard; Isha healers; closed to outsiders)
baseline.why: Each kingdom is a hereditary realm of princely houses whose every able adult serves in the militia, backed by a great navy, healers and temple-schools, closed to outsiders, with elven craftsmanship

laws.lawgroup_governance_principles.source: canon: WFB 8e High Elves (Avelorn: the Everqueen rules as Isha's priestess-queen)
laws.lawgroup_governance_principles.why: A priestess-monarch heads a sacred forest realm.

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB 8e High Elves (Avelorn's sisterhood of Isha)
canon: WFB 8e High Elves (Caledor: Dragon Princes and dragon-riding nobility)
ruling_igs.why: A warrior aristocracy leads the realm.

CDU.note: Citadel of Dusk, the High Elf outpost off southern Lustria (High_Elf_Outposts.JPG); Lothern's colony, baseline laws at principality tier.

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB 8e High Elves (Chrace: White Lions guard the Phoenix Kings; hunters and warriors)

COT.note: Eastern coastal realm; baseline unchanged (source thin).

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB 8e High Elves (Ellyrion: horse-country of the Reaver Knights)

laws.lawgroup_trade_policy.source: canon: WFB 8e High Elves (Lothern is Ulthuan's gateway port; Sea Lords trade with the world)

laws.lawgroup_migration.source: canon: WFB 8e High Elves (foreign merchants are admitted at Lothern)
laws.lawgroup_migration.why: Controlled, not closed, borders at the gateway.

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB 8e High Elves (the Sea Lords of Lothern)

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB 8e High Elves (Nagarythe's Shadow Warriors)

ruling_igs.source: canon: WFB 8e High Elves (Saphery, land of mages: the White Tower and the Loremasters)
